purpose: single-variable same-Value canonical identity reuse; resource gain unmeasured
binary_reuse: No exact-current-dev binary artifact verified; API binaries must be built on Actions, never dot cloud computer

security.unavailable_PG_PSS_IO: null; permission denial cached; no retry using other identity

sampling.root_identity: PID/start_ticks pinned at startup and rechecked before every snapshot
sampling.CPU_average: single core100%; report window seconds and CPU ticks
sampling.incomplete_identity: null plus captured lower bound; never zero/sum/average

requests.scope_excludes: fixture-owned bootstrap/setup/cleanup management HTTP; all synthetic

functional_gates.required_integrity: original Value/byte-size collision and foreign scope refusal; NUL/literal escape/numbers; key/array ordering; section/history/cursor/partial fact commits; sequence rollback/overflow/concurrency; untouched protocol owner
functional_gates.blocking_stage: all positive/negative storage gates and exact source/SQL invariants before release pair
functional_gates.full_protocol_merge_gate: not replaced by storage tests or resource mock; remains required before PR

hash_count_proof.saved: K where write_section independently puts canonical body; standard timing/overview child still1; other callers1 unchanged
hash_count_proof.observed_K: outside-foreground before/after count of body_kind=content and empty content_path; no saved CPU inferred from count

acceptance.performance: same-direction CPU/request gain across both ABBA blocks beyond noise; no CPU percentage until measured
acceptance.metrics: API/PG CPU where available, average/peak/windows, RSS/PSS, SQL/WAL/process IO/file allocation separately; missing fields disclosed
acceptance.latency: TTFT/total P95/P99 with sample N32/arm and window variability; up to500ms tradeoff requires evidence; no averages-only acceptance
acceptance.negative: no repeatable benefit => no PR; failed/incomplete gates => no PR
acceptance.publication: draft PR to current latest dev only after concrete gain and full relevant gates; no merge/deploy

stop: failed run without materially changed fix
